1.title: 1. Introduction
1.content: These Terms of Service (hereinafter, "the Terms") regulate the contractual relationship between Altumia (hereinafter, "Altumia", "we" or "the Company") and the client or user (hereinafter, "the Client" or "you") who hires the technological services offered by Altumia.

2.content: Altumia provides technological services and solutions as agreed in each specific contract, service order, or commercial proposal accepted by the Client.

3.title: 3. Acceptance of Terms

4_1.title: 4.1 Scope
4_1.content: Specific services, deliverables, deadlines, and prices will be detailed in: Commercial proposals, Service orders, Specific contracts, and Technical annexes.

4_2.title: 4.2 Modifications
4_2.content: Altumia reserves the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue any aspect of the services, upon prior notification to the Client when reasonably possible.

items: Provide true, complete, and up-to-date information

Designate an authorized representative for communication and decision-making
Comply with agreed deadlines for reviews and approvals
Make payments within the established terms

Maintain the confidentiality of Client information

7_1.title: 7.1 Prices
7_1.content: Prices will be established in each commercial proposal or specific contract and will be expressed in Colombian Pesos (COP) or US Dollars (USD) as agreed.

7_2.title: 7.2 Invoicing
7_2.content: Altumia will issue electronic invoices in accordance with current Colombian regulations.

items: Payments will be made according to the schedule established in each contract

9.title: 9. Confidentiality
9.content: Both parties agree to keep all sensitive information exchanged confidential, unless it is in the public domain or must be disclosed by legal mandate. This obligation will remain in force for three (3) years after termination.

10.title: 10. Personal Data Protection
10.content: Altumia complies with Law 1581 of 2012 and Decree 1377 of 2013 regarding personal data protection. For more information, please see our Privacy Policy.

11_3.content: Errors reported within thirty (30) days following delivery will be corrected at no cost, provided they are attributable to Altumia.

12.content: To the maximum extent permitted by Colombian law: Total liability shall not exceed the amount paid in the last 6 months. Altumia shall not be liable for lost profits or loss of data.

13.title: 13. Force Majeure
13.content: Neither party shall be liable for failures caused by events beyond their reasonable control, including natural disasters, acts of authority, or infrastructure failures.

14_1.content: Contracts will have the term specified in each particular agreement.

14_2.content: The contract may be terminated if the other party breaches and does not remedy within fifteen (15) days.
